rows.value: 30% up to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, 45% above; no tax-free threshold and no Medicare levy; withheld under Scale 3

rows.note: Federal; paid by: Businesses paying contractors; legal basis: TAA 1953 Sch 1 ss 12-55, 12-60, 12-190; TA Regulations 2017 ss 38, 70; SG(A) Act s 12(3); Fair Work Act s 15AA; ITAA 1997 Divs 84-87; details: contractor-rules

rows.label: Company tax (corporate income tax) and the multinational minimum tax
rows.value: 30%, or 25% for a base rate entity (aggregated turnover under $50 million, no more than 80% passive income); 15% minimum tax for groups with revenue of 750 million euros or more
rows.note: Federal; paid by: Companies; legal basis: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 ss 23-23AB; Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024; details: company-tax-minimum

rows.note: Federal; paid by: Sole traders and small businesses; legal basis: ITAA 1997 Divisions 328 (Subdivisions 328-C, 328-D, 328-F); details: small-business
